title: C1 event to C4
description: Sent by C1 for every request it handles (POST /v1/events/c1), including 0% masked and blocked users.

event_id.description: Unique per event, never reused. C4 drops duplicates. Recommended: evt-cN-<uuid4>

org_id.description: Hospital id, copied from the request

user_id.description: User id, copied from the request

request_id.description: Request id created by the gateway, copied from the request

session_id.description: Session id created by the gateway, copied from the request

masking_percentage.description: Characters of the original prompt replaced by placeholders, divided by the prompt length, times 100, rounded to 1 decimal. 0 means nothing was masked
